meta.title: Cramping upper abdominal pain after meals
meta.candidate_brief: You are the surgical SHO in the emergency department. Take a detailed history from this patient with upper abdominal pain and determine likely causes and risks.

patient_script.opening_statement: I get this awful cramp under my ribs after I eat.

if_asked.symptom_details: It's a sharp, cramping pain under my right ribs that sometimes spreads to my back.
if_asked.timing: Started about two months ago, now happening twice a week, usually an hour after meals.
if_asked.after_effects: I feel nauseous and sweaty during the attacks, which last about an hour.
if_asked.exacerbating: Fatty meals like fried chicken trigger it.
if_asked.relieving: Sitting still and taking paracetamol helps a little; it eventually settles on its own.
if_asked.associated_symptoms: No vomiting or jaundice, but I do feel bloated. No change in bowel habits.
if_asked.past_medical_history: I had gestational diabetes in my last pregnancy but no other issues.
if_asked.medications: I take paracetamol when the pain comes and a daily multivitamin.
if_asked.allergies: I'm allergic to codeine; it makes me itch badly.
if_asked.family_history: Mum had gallbladder surgery in her 50s. Dad has high cholesterol.
if_asked.social_history: I don't smoke, have an occasional glass of wine, stay at home with my toddler, and try to walk daily though I've put on weight.
if_asked.functional_status: I've had to avoid certain foods and it worries me when the pain starts if I'm out with my child.

collateral.observer_note: Husband says she curls up in pain for about an hour when it happens.

patient_script.emotional_tone: Alert but apprehensive, winces when describing pain

patient.name: Maria Lopez
patient.baseline_body_language: Protective hand over right upper quadrant

pc.one_liner: After I eat certain foods I get a bad cramp under my right ribs.

hpc.timing: Episodes last 45-60 minutes, follow fatty meals

sh.diet: High in convenience foods, working on healthier options

ice.ideas: Thinks it might be gallstones like her mum
ice.concerns: Worried it could suddenly get worse when she's alone with her child
ice.expectations: Wants tests to confirm the cause and advice on treatment
